name: radio
title: Radio group
description: One choice from a few options that all stay visible.

when: One choice from 2 to 5 options people should compare.

keyboard.does: Moves and selects within the group.

builtIn: One tab stop for the group.
Required fields show "Fill in this field." after a blur or a submit; your own `errorMessage` replaces it.

genui.description: One choice from a few visible options. items are {value, label, description?}. Emits change.

guidance.rule: Use variant="card" when each option needs a line of detail (a plan, a delivery option, a time slot); its content is yours.
